method: Selected official source passages read through web extraction. The panel report was downloaded from USBR and its extracted text inspected because the web PDF viewer failed. No human verification claimed.

sources.title: Bureau of Reclamation, Teton Dam: History, Failure, and Impact
sources.supports: Page 1: first filling, date and agency fatality total. Page 2: Safety of Dams Act date, review and emergency-exercise practices.
inspectedPassages: PDF p. 1 opening and Key Facts
PDF p. 2 Safety of Dams Program
claimEvidence: First-fill failure; later agency toll; law date and later program practices

sources.title: Independent Panel to Review Cause of Teton Dam Failure, report to Interior and Idaho, December 1976
sources.supports: Transmittal pp. iii–iv; Summary and Conclusions pp. viii–x, especially findings 3–7 and 12–14: erosion, alternative initiators and filling-rate judgment.
inspectedPassages: Transmittal letter dated December 31, 1976, pp. iii–iv
claimEvidence: Internal erosion; two unresolved initiators; slower-filling judgment

sources.title: GAO, Actions Needed to Increase the Safety of Dams, testimony of Henry Eschwege, June 30, 1977
sources.supports: Printed pp. 2–7: comparative review, observation and outlet deficiencies, explicit uncertainty about prevention and review recommendations.
inspectedPassages: Printed pp. 2–5, What Went Wrong at Teton Dam
claimEvidence: Instruments, observation, delayed reporting and unavailable outlet; qualified counterfactual

sources.title: Bureau of Reclamation, Teton Basin Project history, Eric A. Stene
sources.supports: Printed pp. 9–14: breach timing and restoration of irrigation, temporary repairs and claims-program totals.
inspectedPassages: Printed pp. 12–14, Aftermath and Claims Program
claimEvidence: 11:55/11:57 sequence; irrigation recovery; temporary repairs; final claims total

retrievalReceipt.reason: Source URL and precise locators retained instead of a 62.6 MB government report.

limitations: Panel summary p. v says 14 deaths; later USBR history/fact sheet say 11. The draft expressly attributes 11 to Reclamation and does not explain an unverified revision. Human review remains open.
Panel considered slower filling alone; GAO discussed slower filling combined with an available outlet. Do not present these as identical counterfactuals.
Factsheet gives a compressed failure time inconsistent with the detailed project history; the draft uses the history’s 11:55/11:57 sequence.
Only listed passages were inspected; no exhaustive comparison with the 1980 Interior final report.
No claim that monitoring changes would certainly prevent this failure or establish present-day compliance.

rights.sourceSummaryPolicy: Compact paraphrases from four documents; no source photographs or figures reproduced.
